summary: Dell Technologies and co-issuers Dell International L.L.C. and EMC Corporation priced a $5.0B four-tranche senior notes offering under an underwriting agreement dated September 9, 2026: $1.25B 5.100% notes due 2029, $1.25B 5.400% notes due 2031, $1.50B 5.600% notes due 2033 and $1.00B 5.900% notes due 2037. Reoffer prices were 99.953%, 99.836%, 99.475% and 99.694%. Notes are jointly and severally guaranteed on an unsecured basis by Dell Technologies, Denali Intermediate and Dell Inc. Closing expected September 15, 2026, with net proceeds repaying 4.900% first lien notes due 2026 and general corporate purposes. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation.
